subject: Post-call: security discovery & trust portal access request
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Yang <rachel.yang@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: security discovery & trust portal access request

Hi Rachel — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we have alignment:

- Key asks from Nimbus: SOC 2 Type II report, bridge letter or interim attestation, and access to a trust portal for downloading artifacts.
- Scope note: you mentioned potential HIPAA applicability for a pilot scope; we flagged GDPR considerations for EU users and will surface our DPA.
- Immediate next step requested by Nimbus: an intake DDQ/vendor questionnaire (you indicated your procurement team prefers a short DSQ first).

Action items I can take on this week:
1) Share our most recent SOC 2 Type II report if available, plus a bridge letter or interim attestation if the full report is not public.
2) Provision temporary trust-portal access (read-only) and a one-time download link for requested artifacts.
3) Kick off the vendor questionnaire — I attached the initial DDQ we typically use.

Can you confirm the names/emails of everyone on your procurement/security team so we can provision the portal and send the DSQ? If SOC 2 Type II is a blocker, we can propose an interim attestation and highlight compensating controls in the portal.

Attaching call recording and our initial DDQ for your review.

Thanks,
Markus
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: call-recording-20260910.mp4]
[Attachment: initial-ddq.xlsx]

From: Rachel Yang <rachel.yang@nimbushealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Nikhil Bedi <nbedi@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 09:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: security discovery & trust portal access request

Hi Markus — good summary, thanks. A couple of data points from our side: 

- SOC 2 status: We require either a published SOC 2 Type II report covering the past 12 months or a bridge letter plus an interim attestation. If you can provide a bridge letter, that helps speed procurement.
- HIPAA/GDPR: Pilot will likely need a HIPAA BA consideration; GDPR applies only to any EU-subject data. Please include your DPA and any standard BAAs in the trust portal.

Procurement/security contacts:
- Nikhil Bedi (nbedi@nimbushealth.com) — procurement
- Priya Raman (priya.raman@nimbushealth.com) — security/compliance (she prefers portal-based evidence)

For the DDQ: please send the shorter DSQ first — we'll push to our vendor security team for an expedited review. If you can provision the trust portal with read-only links for the SOC 2 report (or bridge letter + controls evidence) that would be ideal.

We typically need access for 3 business days for documentation downloads. Do you have a standard expiry window for temporary access?

Thanks,
Rachel
Director, Procurement — Nimbus Health

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Yang <rachel.yang@nimbushealth.com>, Nikhil Bedi <nbedi@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2026 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: security discovery & trust portal access request

Thanks Rachel — adding Evelyn from our security team to coordinate evidence access and the DPA/BAA. Evelyn, can you: 

- Confirm whether we can share the full SOC 2 Type II report for the last audit cycle, or if we should provide a bridge letter + interim attestation?
- Provision a temporary trust-portal invite for the three Nimbus reviewers (Rachel, Nikhil, Priya) with a 5-business-day window and read-only permissions.
- Upload a short DPA and our standard BAA template to the portal.

Proposed timeline: portal invite by EOB tomorrow (14 Sep), DSQ sent today, and bridge letter provided if SOC 2 public release is restricted.

Monica — I started the DSQ you can tailor; I'm attaching a condensed vendor DSQ for procurement.

Markus
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: condensed-dsq.xlsx]

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2026 17:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: security discovery & trust portal access request

On Mon, Sep 13, 2026 at 08:42 AM Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Thanks Rachel — adding Evelyn from our security team to coordinate evidence access and the DPA/BAA.

Hi all — quick update from security: 

- SOC 2 artifacts: We can share a redacted SOC 2 Type II report covering Jan–Dec 2025. If Nimbus requires an unredacted copy, we will need a mutual NDA and a signed evidence handling agreement — I can circulate both templates.
- Bridge letter: we can produce a bridge letter dated 2026-09-14 that summarizes any post-audit exceptions and the scope.
- Portal: temporary trust-portal invite will be created for rachel.yang, nbedi@nimbushealth.com, priya.raman. Access will be read-only and expire after 5 business days. We will include: SOC2-redacted-2025.pdf, SOC2-bridge-letter-20260914.pdf, DPA-Redwood-2026.pdf, BAA-template.pdf, and a short controls summary.

EOB tomorrow for the invite and uploads. Evelyn
Senior Manager, Security & Compliance — Redwood Inference

From: Rachel Yang <rachel.yang@nimbushealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: security discovery & trust portal access request

Hi Evelyn — thanks, that plan works. Received the portal invite and briefly reviewed the uploaded artifacts; two quick asks before full procurement review:

1) Can you include a one-paragraph summary on data residency and where keys are managed? Our security team wants explicit confirmation about encryption key locations (KMS region).
2) Please add a signed bridge letter PDF (scannable) in the same folder.

We'll aim to complete the DSQ within 3 business days after the portal evidence review. If any NDA is required for an unredacted report, please send the NDA template and we will route for signature.

Link to portal (received): https://redwood-trustportal.example.com/session/abc123 (expires 2026-09-21)

Regards,
Rachel
Director, Procurement — Nimbus Health
